text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementZoologyHow Crocodiles Survived the Asteroid That Killed the DinosaursThey knew the most important rule in real estateJCBy Jake Currie3:30 PM CDT on October 21, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleDinosaurs and crocodilians popped up around the same time roughly 245 million years ago, but only one group survived the asteroid impact 65 million years ago (avian dinosaurs, aside). But why? According to a new study published in Science Advances, the secret of crocodile success boils down to three things: location, location, location.  A team of researchers led by paleontologists from University College London examined over 7,000 fossils and records belonging to more than 400 species (living and dead) from pseudosuchia, a larger group that includes crocodilians. They then compared the records to computer models reconstructing Earth’s changing climate over the past 245 million years to map out the global history of the group across space and time.Read more: “This Ancient Crocodile Ancestor Learned to Walk on Two Legs”Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
